recordings.previousText: A drawn game. Neither side could force more, and the turning points are still worth study.
recordings.text: A drawn game, and a draw keeps its lessons as surely as a win. The choices along the way repay study.
recordings.reason: A draw by repetition can come in a winning position, so 'neither side could force more' is not always true.

recordings.previousText: The earlier setback is answered here, and the position is playable once more. A setback need not be the end of the lesson.
recordings.text: The earlier setback no longer rules the board, and the position is playable once more. A setback need not be the end of the lesson.
recordings.reason: A move never raises its own evaluation; the opponent's moves made the game playable again, so the take no longer credits this move or the learner.
